Hey there—welcome. Have you ever wondered why you reach for your phone first thing in the morning, or how some routines just seem to run on autopilot? Patterns shape every part of our day, often guiding us even when we don’t realize it. From the way we start our mornings, to the habits that drive success at work, these invisible routines can quietly influence everything we do.
Together, we’re about to dive into the fascinating world Charles Duhigg explores in The Power of Habit: Why We Do What We Do in Life and Business. He uncovers the science behind those automatic behaviors—showing us how habits are formed, how they stick, and most importantly, how they can be changed. Imagine unlocking the secret behind that loop of cue, routine, and reward. What if understanding this could help you transform your own life—or even reshape the culture of a whole company?
We’ll journey through real stories from individuals, businesses, and even entire social movements, discovering how small changes can spark incredible results. You’ll see how keystone habits have the power to create ripple effects, turning ordinary routines into paths for growth, happiness, and lasting change.
So, as we set out on this journey together, get ready to take a closer look at the routines that shape your world. Who knows? By the end, you might just see your daily habits—and your potential for transformation—in a whole new light.
